description: Start watching a mark for NEW confusingly similar filings. This CREATES a watch (a side effect — it stores the watch and sends a confirmation email with the stop link). Runs a baseline screen first — everything already on the register is marked seen, so you are only alerted on filings that appear AFTER the watch starts. Returns JSON with the watch id, its classes/threshold/schedule, and the baseline hits (for context). Check for new filings with check_watches, or let the scheduled checker run (daily by default, or weekly / every N days if you set a schedule). An email is required — it is the watch's owner, and the digest goes there (needs RESEND_API_KEY on the server; without it the watch still works and records hits, and alerts start once email is switched on). The email must be verified first — call request_watch_code, then pass the email and code (or the session token); without verification the watch is refused, so nobody can attach someone else's inbox. SCREEN ONLY — not clearance, not legal advice.

classes.description: Nice classes (1-45) if known; otherwise inferred

code.description: 6-digit code from request_watch_code, for the email above

email.description: Email address for new-filing alerts (required). Must be verified — see request_watch_code.

goodsDescription.description: What you sell, e.g. 'music streaming app'

schedule.description: How often the scheduled checker looks at this watch: 'daily' (every morning, default), 'weekly' (Tuesdays after the Gazette), or 'custom' (every scheduleDays days)

scheduleDays.description: For schedule 'custom': check every N days (2–30)

sessionToken.description: 60-minute watch session token from a previous verification, for the email above

threshold.description: Minimum risk score to alert on (0.45 = MEDIUM and up, 0.65 = MEDIUM-HIGH and up, 0.85 = HIGH only)

name: watch_mark
